name: The Lost
overview: Scripture reveals that those who are lost are separated from salvation because they do not believe, as Jesus declared that belief and baptism lead to salvation while unbelief results in condemnation. The Lord’s mission is clear: He came to seek and save the lost, exemplified in His reaching out to sinners and publicans. God's love for the world is demonstrated by giving His only Son so that whoever believes in Him will have eternal life, and Jesus is the exclusive way to the Father. This truth calls believers to pray earnestly for the lost and to understand the compassionate heart of Christ toward those who have gone astray, like the lost sheep.
